mentions.name: OpenCook
mentions.description: An open source recipe web app with AI features, rebuilt by extracting the author's curated recipes from StashCook using Codex.
mentions.problem: StashCook requires a subscription just to read your own recipes on the web app, locking recipe data behind a paywall.
mentions.source_excerpt: Another app: OpenCook https://open-cook.com/ . We curated and wrote our own recipes into StashCook, which requires a subscription just to read your own recipes on the web app.
